title: The Rajasthan royal trail
alt: Amber Fort overlooking the Aravalli hills in Rajasthan
description: Pink-city mornings, blue lanes, and one unforgettable desert sunset. A colourful route through Rajasthan's most-loved corners.
fullDescription: Take in the grand forts, old markets, and warm desert evenings of Rajasthan at a relaxed pace. This route balances landmark moments with time to wander, shop, and settle into each city.

itinerary.title: Arrive in the Pink City
itinerary.text: Check into Jaipur and spend the evening settling in with a relaxed local dinner.

itinerary.title: Forts and façades
itinerary.text: Explore Amber Fort and Jaipur's historic streets, with time for cafés and local crafts.

itinerary.title: On to the Blue City
itinerary.text: Travel to Jodhpur and enjoy an unhurried evening around the old quarter.

itinerary.title: A city above the rooftops
itinerary.text: Visit Mehrangarh Fort and wander the blue lanes below it at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Golden hour in Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: Travel west to Jaisalmer for a desert sunset and an evening under wide open skies.

itinerary.title: One last chai
itinerary.text: Enjoy breakfast before your onward transfer, taking a little Rajasthan colour with you.
